source: Authenticated Android build captured from the local GymFeed emulator and device exports.

screenshots.title: Coach hub
screenshots.description: GymFeed Coach hub with Pro upgrade card and the connected AI tool grid.
approved_claims: Coach brings food scan, equipment scan, AI Trainer and body scan into one hub.
screenshots.review_note: Current UI contains the unsupported absolute phrase 'Identify any machine instantly'; do not use in marketing until that product copy is corrected or the tile is safely redacted.
